lines.text: Nina's friend slipped on wet leaves and scraped her hand.
Nina had a first-aid kit, somewhere at the bottom of her pack.
She dumped everything onto the muddy trail to find it.
Here's the fix. Keep first aid on the outside, in a pouch you can reach in seconds.
Tell your group where it is before you start.
Next time, Nina had it open before her friend sat down.
Save this before your next group hike.
